subject.title: Feature Request: Slack-Style @Mention Autocomplete in Control UI Chat

question: Should @agent autocomplete extend the existing Control UI composer and `agents.list` metadata path, introduce a new `agents.directory` plus rich-chip input path, or be deferred?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing composer behavior and possibly a new gateway API, and current code already has a related slash suggestion model plus agent metadata that may be sufficient.

options.title: Scope a shared composer suggestion model
options.body: Use the existing slash-menu and `agents.list` surfaces as the starting point, adding new API only for proven metadata gaps.

options.title: Approve a dedicated directory and chip editor
options.body: Treat `agents.directory` and rich mention chips as a new Control UI/API direction with explicit accessibility and upgrade proof.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Leave the composer slash-only until broader web frontend priorities or adjacent custom-term autocomplete are scoped.

recommendation.title: Scope a shared composer suggestion model
recommendation.body: Use the existing slash-menu and `agents.list` surfaces as the starting point, adding new API only for proven metadata gaps.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest nearby history around the current composer suggestion UX and related product triage.
